seasonRead.headline: 2015–16: High-touch scoring leads without closing the field
paragraphs: The 2015–16 model learned 6 forward styles. High-Touch Risk/Reward Scorer led with 209 of 463 forwards (45.1%), followed by High-Volume Playmaking Scorer at 23.3%.

High-Touch Risk/Reward Scorer owns the plurality at 45.1%, but 12.7% of forwards remain outside the top three. That leaves a clear first identity alongside a real specialist tier, rather than a closed three-style market.

seasonRead.headline: 2015–16: Puck-moving control carries the plurality
paragraphs: The 2015–16 model learned 4 defense styles. Play-Driving Puck-Moving Defenseman led with 108 of 239 defenders (45.2%), followed by Shot-Blocking Defensive Defenseman at 31.0%.
Play-Driving Puck-Moving Defenseman leads a four-style defense map without reaching a majority. The top two take 76.2%, leaving 23.8% split between the remaining profiles.
